pages.title: Camo Hunt
pages.creator: Chorelet
pages.description:
Camo Hunt hides painted little characters called Splotches in rooms and gardens. Zoom into the scene and look for eyes that give away a hiding spot. Find them all before the timer runs out.

There are five worlds with 20 levels each, plus a Halloween event, a daily hunt and an endless mode. Collect skins as you play, or share a code that lets a friend search for your character.

pages.title: Zombie Sprint
pages.creator: merrymaker14
pages.description: Zombie Sprint puts eight zombie racers on the track for a three-lap race. Pick a racer and drift through corners as you try to move ahead of seven rivals. Collect power-ups along the way and look for a chance to pass before the final lap ends. The championship runs across four different tracks.

pages.title: Arrows Flow
pages.creator: Infinite Emerge
pages.description: Arrows Flow asks you to clear a board of winding arrows. An arrow can leave only in the direction its tip points, so check whether the route is open before you select it. Removing one arrow can free the next. Start with the tutorial and use power-ups when a later board leaves you stuck.

pages.title: Wood Screw Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Wood Screw Puzzle gives you wooden structures held together by fasteners. Look at what each screw, nut or bolt is holding before taking it out. The order changes which pieces can come free, so consider how the structure will move after your choice. Take it apart by finding a workable sequence.

pages.title: Flower Fairy Adventure Story
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Flower Fairy Adventure Story follows a fairy who has lost her wings. Solve little jigsaw puzzles to help her continue her adventure. Fit the pieces together and look for details that show where each fragment belongs. The game also lets you choose clothes for the girl as you work through the story.

pages.title: Associations
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Associations is a word puzzle about finding connections between terms. Read the words on the board and look for ones that share an idea. Some links are easier to see after comparing a few possibilities, so check the group before committing to it. The levels have no timer, giving you room to think.

pages.title: Stick War Saga
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stick War Saga puts you in command of a stickman army. Mine resources, use them to build up your forces and send those forces into battle. Decide when you have enough troops to attack and when to keep developing your army. The campaign takes you through battles for enemy territory.

pages.title: Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Claw & Merge: Labubu Drop gives you dolls to drop and merge. Bring two matching Labubus together to create the next doll in the collection and earn coins. Spend those coins to operate the claw machine and retrieve a doll you need for the level. Think about where each doll will land before dropping another.

pages.title: Juicy Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Juicy Match 2 takes you to a juice bar where matching fruit is how you make the drinks. Line up at least three of a kind and look for moves that set off chain reactions for bonuses. The Banana character offers tips along the way. Work through hundreds of levels or try the daily missions and weekly challenges.

pages.title: Run Now
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Run Now sends you through mazes where getting past an obstacle can take a little puzzle solving. Guide the character through each level and look for hidden routes when the obvious way is blocked. Pick up rewards along the way. Some sections call for a quick move, while others give you a reason to stop and consider the route.

pages.title: Number Merge 10
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Number Merge 10 asks you to clear numbers by selecting a rectangle on the board. Add up the values inside the area. If the total is exactly ten, all the numbers in that rectangle disappear. Look for different groups that can reach the target, and see what selections are still possible after each clear.

pages.title: Land Cruiser Offroad Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Land Cruiser Offroad Driver lets you take an SUV and your dog around a large city map. Choose from four modes, customize the vehicle and use upgrades to develop it. Earn money by drifting. If your driving draws police attention, be ready to deal with a chase as you make your way across the map.

pages.title: Billiards 3D: Russian Pyramid
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Billiards 3D: Russian Pyramid lets you play Russian pyramid against computer opponents. Choose a table size and set the opponent's skill before the match. Line up shots and think about where the balls will stop after a hit. Adjust the difficulty when you want more room to practice or a stronger opponent.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Italian Brainrot Jigsaw has fifteen pictures of meme characters to reassemble. Choose a picture and solve it with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Look for colors and shapes that carry across a seam as you find where the fragments fit. Try to finish quickly, or choose more pieces for a harder version of the same picture.

pages.title: Kings and Queens Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Kings and Queens Match 2 joins Princess Bella on a journey through jewel and crown puzzles. Match pieces in groups of three and clear obstacles on the way to hidden treasures. Use boosters such as royal bombs, hammers and arrows to help when a layout gets in your way. The sequel has more than 2,500 levels.

pages.title: Triple Tile Twister Match Game
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Triple Tile Twister Match Game gives you a holding area with room for seven tiles. Select tiles from the board to move them there, and gather three identical ones to clear the set. Think about what each choice leaves in the tray. The game ends if the area fills before you can complete a match.

pages.title: My Hospital Learn Care
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: My Hospital Learn Care lets you build a hospital scene and place dolls in it. Set up the space as a hospital of your own, then choose where the characters go. You can change the arrangement as you play. The focus is creating a hospital world and acting out scenes in it.

pages.title: Choco Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Choco Blocks asks you to complete rows by dropping sets of blocks onto a board. Some rows contain chocolate blocks you need to collect. Look at which placements bring you closer to clearing those rows, then keep fitting pieces into the spaces that remain. Gather the required chocolate before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Save Baby Capybaras - Pull Pin
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Save Baby Capybaras - Pull Pin gives you a set of pins between baby capybaras and their father. Pull the ones that open a safe route for the babies. Some pins should stay where they are, since removing them can interfere with the rescue. Complete puzzles and spend earned rubies on character skins.

pages.title: Stickman Warrior Way
pages.creator: DiCooperGames
pages.description:
Stickman Warrior Way sends you through 18 mazes to stop an ancient threat. Fight enemies and collect enough energy to open the portal to the next stage. Many layouts offer more than one route, so explore when a path gets blocked.

On a keyboard, use A and D to move, W to jump and Space to punch. Press W again in the air to double jump across a larger gap.

pages.title: Ultimate Flying Car 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Ultimate Flying Car 2 puts you in a car that can drive through city streets and take off to explore from above. Use nitro when you want more speed and try the explosive action as you move around the map. Play alone or play with a friend in two-player mode. Each player has their own keys for nitro, camera changes and resetting the car.

pages.title: Dino Digg
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description: Dino Digg takes you from a fossil dig to a dinosaur museum. Dig up bones, clean what you find and use the pieces to build skeletons for your collection. Each step has a different job, from uncovering a piece to preparing it for display. Keep digging to find more material for the museum.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Monster Truck Race
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Mega Ramp Monster Truck Race puts you behind the wheel of a 4x4 monster truck. Take the truck along stunt routes and get it through the course. Watch where a ramp leads and adjust the approach before the truck leaves the ground. The challenge is handling the large vehicle through the changing terrain.

pages.title: Extreme Run 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Extreme Run 3D puts you on an endless obstacle course in a 3D world. Move sideways with the Left and Right arrows and jump with Up or Space. Look ahead so you can decide which way to move before reaching the next barrier or gap. See how long you can keep the run going.

pages.title: Sorority Fall Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Sorority Fall Fashion gets a group of friends ready to welcome autumn. Browse the wardrobe and put together a fall outfit for each one. Try different clothing combinations and see which pieces work together. You can keep a shared style across the group or give each friend a different seasonal look.

pages.title: Save The Ball 3D
pages.creator: CHETRUSCA SOFTWORKS S.R.L
pages.description: Save The Ball 3D gives you a black hole to move in front of a ball. Guide the hole under the objects on the course so they fall in and leave a clear route. Watch what is still in the ball's way before moving farther along the stage. Get the ball to the finish line.

pages.title: BU
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: BU asks you to throw pins into a rotating planet. Move your cursor or finger to set the direction, then click or tap to release a pin. Watch where the pins you have already placed are turning. Time the next throw so it reaches an open spot without hitting another pin.

pages.title: Car Simulator Racing Car game
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Car Simulator Racing Car game lets you drive and drift sports cars in a 3D simulator. Watch how the car handles as it turns, and how impacts damage it. Customize the vehicle with changes to parts such as the engine, tires and rims. Try the car again to see how it responds after you make adjustments.

pages.title: Crossword Kingdom
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Crossword Kingdom gives you letters to connect into words that fit a crossword. Look at the empty spaces and use the available letters to build words of the right length. Correct words fill the puzzle. You can also earn extra points for other valid words you find along the way.

pages.title: Catland: block puzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Catland: block puzzle gives you cat-shaped pieces to fit into a grid. Drag a cat onto the field and click its center if you need to rotate it. Fill every square with the available pieces to finish the puzzle. Work through four chapters and use a hint if you cannot find a fit.

pages.title: Agent Fight 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Agent Fight 3D gives you fighting skills to choose from before taking on an opponent. Hold to attack, then release when red text warns you an enemy strike is coming. Letting go gives you a chance to defend or dodge. Watch for that cue while you attack so you can change your response in time.

pages.title: Matches Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Dinmo Games
pages.description: Matches Puzzle Game gives you a figure or an incorrect calculation made from matchsticks. Move, add or remove the sticks according to the puzzle until the result works. Use all the required matches, and look for a different arrangement when the first idea fails. Many puzzles accept more than one solution, and the light bulb button offers hints.

pages.title: Flying Fire Truck Driving Sim
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Flying Fire Truck Driving Sim has you respond to fires across a city in a truck that can fly. Drive or take off to reach an emergency, then work to put out the fire and rescue people in burning buildings. Pay attention to what each response calls for before moving on to the next rescue.

pages.title: Farm Fun
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Farm Fun asks you to free animals from a crowded paddock. Move them forward or backward to get around fences, barrels and shrubs. Pair matching animals as they come out, and look for a route that frees up room for the animals still inside. Clear the paddock to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Stairs Trivia
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Stairs Trivia turns correct answers into steps toward the top. Read the question, choose an answer and take the stairs that lead onward when you get it right. Other contestants are working their way up as well. Keep making accurate choices to advance and try to be the last one standing.

pages.title: Traffic Jam 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Traffic Jam 3D puts you behind the wheel for timed driving challenges. Depending on the event, you may need to reach checkpoints, score a set number of points or cover a distance before time runs out. Watch for room to pass as you drive through traffic and keep the current objective in mind.

pages.title: Link the numbers
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Link the numbers gives you a wooden board with numbers to connect in order. Start at 1 and draw a route through 2, 3 and the remaining numbers. Look ahead before making a turn, since the route still needs to reach every later number. Work through the boards to see how their paths change.

pages.title: Towerland
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Towerland is a top-down shooter where you fight monsters and work toward boss encounters. Move around the arena to keep clear of threats while you aim back at them. Unlock power-ups as you play and try the three game modes. The game also has three bosses to take on.

pages.title: Scary Maze
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Scary Maze puts you inside a 3D maze in first person. Find the key, then get it to the gate so you can escape. A route that gets you to the key still has to leave you a way out. Try to find both quickly and see whether you can improve your time.

pages.title: Party Stickman 4 Player
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Party Stickman 4 Player asks four players to get their stick figures through 15 levels together. Watch where the other characters are before moving on, because a mistake can send everyone back. If any stick figure dies, the entire level restarts. Help each other get through the same route safely.

pages.title: Professions
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: Professions asks you to match objects to the people who use them at work. Look at the profession shown and choose the object that belongs with it. Think about what each tool is for before making a choice. The activity helps you connect everyday jobs with the equipment they use.

pages.title: Baby Chicco Adventures
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Baby Chicco Adventures sends a little penguin through a platform game world. Move Chicco past obstacles and use his jump, flight and shots to get through the stages. Use A and D or the Left and Right arrows to move, W, Z or Up to jump or fly, and X or J to shoot.

pages.title: Shooting Balls
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Shooting Balls gives you a stream of balls to fire at blocks. Aim so the balls can bounce into several blocks before returning. Each hit reduces a block's remaining strength until it breaks. Pick up extra balls to make later shots more effective, and keep clearing blocks as they move down the screen.

pages.title: Winter Bubbles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Winter Bubbles is a bubble shooter played with colored candles. Aim a candle at others of the same kind to make a match and clear space. Collect the Golden Bell before time runs out and keep the candles away from the border. Some shots can activate power-ups, giving you another way to get through a crowded layout.

pages.title: Super Phantom Rabbit
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Super Phantom Rabbit follows a rabbit trying to reach the guards and join their army. Get through the forest and stay clear of the monsters along the way. Look at where each threat is before choosing how to pass it. Help the rabbit make it to the guards at the end of the adventure.

pages.title: Tower Run
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Tower Run sends a hero toward towers where princesses are waiting. Click to help him climb while riding balls, and keep track of how high he needs to get. If he falls, the balls break. The aim is to keep climbing through the course and reach the princess before someone else does.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: 100.000+ Fun Puzzles
pages.creator: Holger Sindbaek
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle: 100.000+ Fun Puzzles lets you pick an image from a catalog of themed puzzle collections. Use the preview when you need a reference or show the borders to help with assembly. The settings also let you shuffle pieces, hide the timer and change the sound. Choose another picture when the current one is complete.

pages.title: Derby Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Derby Racing puts you on a horse in races against other riders. Tap the Left and Right arrow keys in succession to pick up speed. Winning opens harder events with longer distances and faster horses. Work through the races until you face the legendary horses in the final event, then try to finish ahead of them.

pages.title: Touch Capital Letters
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Touch Capital Letters asks you to pick out uppercase letters before they disappear. Tap a capital when you see one and leave the lowercase letters alone. Each correct selection adds to your score. Look at the shape of each letter as it appears so you can decide quickly which ones to touch.

pages.title: Clash of Goblins
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Clash of Goblins is a real-time strategy game about sending units to destroy the opposing base. Choose which goblins to deploy and when to send them into battle. Try combinations that work together and adjust the next group to what is happening on the field. Keep up the attack until the enemy base falls.

pages.title: Fervent Frog Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description: Fervent Frog Escape is a point-and-click puzzle about freeing a frog. Use the mouse to explore the rooms and look for clues. Check what you find against the puzzles and locked doors in your way. Solving one clue can give you access to another area as you work toward the rescue.

pages.title: 6 Cards To Win
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: 6 Cards To Win puts you and other survivors in a card game against a monster. Choose a card to play, then see what the others put down. The monster counts the cards to decide who advances, and the last player in each round loses the card they played. Make your choices carefully so you can be the one who escapes. Unlock more monsters and survivors as you play.

pages.title: Parkour Run 3D.IO
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Parkour Run 3D.IO is a race through a course full of barriers. Keep running toward the finish and work out how to get past each obstacle without giving up your lead. Watch what is ahead of the other runners as well as your own route. The goal is to get through first.

pages.title: Yukon Solitaire
pages.creator: Solitaire Paradise
pages.description: Yukon Solitaire asks you to move every card from the tableau to the foundations. You can move a group of uncovered cards together even when the cards in that group are out of sequence. Look for a move that frees a card you need, then keep building the foundations until the tableau is clear.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Car Stunt Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Mega Ramp Car Stunt Game puts you in a car on elevated stunt courses. Drive over ramps and through layouts that leave little room to correct a turn. Judge your approach before the car takes off, then keep it lined up as you land. Work through the tracks as the routes get more demanding.

pages.title: Geometry Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Geometry Jump sends your chosen character through a course of geometric shapes and obstacles. Tap the screen to jump at the right moment, then watch for the next gap or barrier as you land. If a jump goes wrong, try the level again and use what you saw to improve the timing.

pages.title: Hidden Object Easter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Hidden Object Easter gives you an Easter scene and a list of things to find on the left of the screen. Look through the picture and click each object when you spot it. Use the list to keep track of what is still missing. Finish within the time limit for a bonus.

pages.title: UFO Arkanoid Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: UFO Arkanoid Deluxe has you move a paddle with the mouse to keep a ball bouncing. Send it into the UFOs and try to break up each wave before the next one reaches you. Move into position to return the ball as it comes back down. The waves keep coming as you play.

pages.title: Pixel Coloring Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pixel Coloring Time lets you choose a pixel art picture and color it in the browser. Pick shades for the different parts of the image and build up the picture one area at a time. You can also print a page to color on paper if you want to work on it away from the screen.

pages.title: car parking game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: In car parking game, you steer a car through parking courses and bring it into the marked space. Watch the edges of the route as you turn and avoid hitting the obstacles around the bay. Change the camera view if you need a better angle to line up the car. Finish one parking course to move on to the next.

pages.title: Winter Dash
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Winter Dash sends you through a winter obstacle course. Jump or fly through the gaps and collect gifts on the way to the finish line. Look ahead as the route changes so you can time the next move. Use the gifts you gather to shop for new characters to take into later runs.

pages.title: My Dream Doctor
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: My Dream Doctor puts you in a virtual hospital with different patients to treat. Pick up the game's tools and follow the tasks for each case, including emergency operations. The work changes depending on which patient arrives. Complete the treatment on screen to finish a case and move on to another one.

pages.title: Kids Cartoon Puzzle
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Kids Cartoon Puzzle gives you nine cartoon pictures to put together. Choose a puzzle and look for pieces with colors or lines that continue from one fragment to the next. Fit them into the layout until the image is complete. Switch to another picture when you are ready for a new puzzle.

pages.title: Sweet Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Sweet Truck sends you out in a truck to gather cookies. Use the arrow keys or the on-screen buttons to drive and collect the treats before reaching the end of the level. Watch where the truck is headed while you go after a pickup. Gather cookies to score and avoid crashing along the route.

pages.title: Circle Round Pool
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Circle Round Pool takes place on a circular table with no pockets. Aim your shot so the moving ball makes contact with the others. Think about how it can rebound across the table to reach a ball on the far side. Touch all the balls to finish the current level.

pages.title: Crazy Mexican Coloring Book
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Crazy Mexican Coloring Book gives you eight pictures to color and a palette of 23 shades. Choose a drawing and apply your colors to it. Finishing quickly can improve the score, or you can spend time trying combinations. Use the save option to keep a copy of the finished picture.

pages.title: Fire City Truck Rescue Driving Simulator
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Fire City Truck Rescue Driving Simulator gives you a fire truck and missions to respond to around the city. Drive to calls involving buildings or vehicles and carry out the rescue. Finished missions earn points that can unlock more trucks. Choose which one to take before heading to the next emergency.

pages.title: Real Car Racing Game : Car Racing Championship
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Real Car Racing Game : Car Racing Championship lets you drive sports cars on tracks, winding roads and city streets. Race against other drivers or work on setting a faster lap time. Use the open city to explore and try drifting through turns. Adjust your approach to suit the route and the event.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Halloween
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Halloween asks you to clear a descending group of bubbles before it touches the ground. Aim your shot at matching bubbles so the group bursts and earns points. Look for places where a shot can open more room. Keep clearing pieces as the lower edge moves closer.

pages.title: One Hand Cowboy
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: One Hand Cowboy gives a Wild West sheriff twelve rounds of target practice. Watch where the next target is and line up your aim before firing. Get through each round to take on a harder shooting challenge. The goal is to finish all twelve levels and prove the sheriff can hit his marks.

pages.title: Paint the Rings
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Paint the Rings asks you to shoot paint balls at rotating rings. Click to fire and watch where the next unpainted section will be when the shot reaches it. Cover the pieces to finish the ring, then move on to the next layout. Check the rotation before firing again so the shot goes where you intend.

pages.title: Transport Dinos To The Dino Zoo
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Transport Dinos To The Dino Zoo puts you in a truck carrying a dinosaur through the jungle. Follow the route to the zoo while keeping clear of the other dinosaurs in the area. Watch the road and the creatures around it as you drive. The job is to get your cargo safely to its destination.

pages.title: Alien Bot Madness
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Alien Bot Madness puts you in charge of defending a city wall against robots. Aim and shoot with the mouse, and use A or D for special abilities when you need extra help. Earn money and spend it on upgrades. Keep the robots away from the wall as the attacks continue.

pages.title: io Games Wormate 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: In io Games Wormate 2, you steer a worm through an arena and collect food to grow. Use the arrow keys to change direction and look ahead for a clear route to the next pieces of food. Other worms move around the same area, so watch where they are headed as you make each turn.

pages.title: Subtraction Math Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Subtraction Math Challenge gives you ten seconds to answer each subtraction question. Work out what is left after taking away the second number, then select the answer before time runs out. The short timer makes speed part of the challenge. Stay focused as each new problem replaces the last one.

pages.title: Marco
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Marco sends you through platform levels where you can jump over obstacles and shoot at enemies. Collect coins along the way and use the shop and power-ups to prepare for later stages. Look ahead for a safe landing before jumping. Reach the end of the current level to continue through the map.

pages.title: Princess Purse First Rule
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Purse First Rule lets you design a clutch for Moana to take to a party. Pick the shape and look of the bag, then try decorations and accessories to make it your own. Compare the details as you add them. Finish a design that suits the entrance you want Moana to make.

pages.title: Adventure of Curious Knight
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Adventure of Curious Knight sends a knight through four stages to collect coins and diamonds. Guide him along the route and pick up the treasures you can reach. The pickups add to your score, so look at where they are before moving to the next area. Finish all four levels to complete the adventure.

pages.title: Mermaid Resurrection Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Mermaid Resurrection Emergency puts you in charge of a mermaid princess's care after a shark attack. Follow the fictional emergency-room tasks and watch the heartbeat display as the scene progresses. When the game signals that her heartbeat has dropped, use the on-screen resuscitation activity. Continue through the prompts to help her recover.

pages.title: Hostage Rescue
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hostage Rescue puts you in the role of an agent fighting through five locations to rescue hostages. Aim at the enemies who appear and react before they can shoot back. Watch your ammunition and reload when the gun is empty. Keep track of new threats as you move through each location.

pages.title: Wedding Day Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Wedding Day Preps has Elsa getting ready for her sister Anna's wedding. Pick a dress for Anna, then help Elsa decorate the garden for the ceremony. Try different choices for the outfit and the setting so they work together. Finish both parts of the preparation before the wedding is ready.

pages.title: Real Soccer Pro
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Real Soccer Pro asks you to get the ball past opposing players and score. Guide the ball around the defenders and watch the goalkeeper before making your shot. Look for a route that leaves you room to aim when you get close to the goal. Keep scoring to improve your total.

pages.title: Draw This
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Draw This is a multiplayer drawing and guessing game. When it is your turn to draw, make a sketch of the word so the other players can work it out. When someone else draws, watch the picture take shape and enter a guess. The roles switch as the group works through new words.

pages.title: Cinderella Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Cinderella Twins Birth follows Cinderella on the day her twins arrive. Help her through the game's activities while she waits for the ambulance, then visit the babies at the hospital. Weigh them and feed them when they are hungry. The story moves through these tasks as Cinderella meets her twins.

pages.title: Crystal Gem Garnet Dress Up
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Crystal Gem Garnet Dress Up gives you a wardrobe based on Garnet's looks from Steven Universe. Try her early yellow scarf, later forms and beach clothes, or explore options based on fusions such as Sugilite and Sardonyx. Change hair and facial expressions as you build a look. You can also create versions of Ruby and Sapphire.

pages.title: Flicking Soccer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Flicking Soccer gives you a team to control in a tabletop-style soccer match. Flick pieces toward the ball and try to send it into the opponent's goal. Think about the angle of each flick before taking it. Outscore your opponent and move on to the next match as you work through the competition.

pages.title: Basket Monsterz
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Basket Monsterz puts monsters on the basketball court to settle who is the better shooter. Move the pointer to aim and try to reach 11 points before your opponent in the Monsterz' Cup. You can also choose the time challenge and see how much you can score before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Freshman Party at Princess College
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Freshman Party at Princess College follows Elsa and Ariel as they throw a party for new students Anna and Moana. Decorate the college hall first, then choose party looks for the older students. Finish by styling the two freshmen. Try different outfits for each of the four before the party begins.

pages.title: Fruit Fever World
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Fruit Fever World asks you to match fruit for customers in a jungle setting. Use the mouse to select fruit and line up three or more of the same kind. Check what the customer needs before making a match so your move helps fill the order. Keep serving the requested fruit as the board changes.

pages.title: Sushi Madness
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Sushi Madness gives you sushi to match in rows of three. Check the plate below the board to see which pieces the order needs. Match beside a bento box to break it for extra points. If you need help, the chopsticks booster clears a cross and the dango booster collects the requested sushi.

pages.title: Princesses Boyfriend Rivals
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princesses Boyfriend Rivals follows Aurora and Cinderella after they meet Charming at college. Choose which princess you want to help, then put together a look for her. Browse the available clothes and try combinations that suit your choice. The outfit is your way of helping her stand out in the rivalry.
